_doc: Story dialogue + level bridges. {name} = player's name (localStorage 'playerName'). voice = id in assets/voice/manifest.json (empty = text only). after: 'name_input' shows the name box when the line ends.

intro.en: Well hello there, friend! Welcome, welcome!
intro.zh: 嘿，你好呀，朋友！欢迎，欢迎！

intro.en: I'm Dingo, head chef of this little kitchen. What's your name?
intro.zh: 我是 Dingo，这间小厨房的主厨。你叫什么名字？

intro.en: {name}! What a great name. So happy to meet you!
Today's a big day. My two little apprentices are learning to cook, and I need a helper. That's you!
intro.zh: 今天可是个大日子。我的两个小学徒在学做饭，我需要一个小帮手——就是你！

intro.en: Let's make some yummy onion soup together. Ready? Follow me!
intro.zh: 我们一起来做好喝的洋葱汤吧。准备好了吗？跟我来！

l0>l1.en: Nice work, {name}! Now Wendy's turn. Can you teach her with stars?
l0>l1.zh: 干得好，{name}！现在轮到 Wendy 了。你能用星星教她吗？

l1>l2.en: Wendy's learning! But Kai never wants to try new things... let's help him explore.
l1>l2.zh: Wendy 在进步！可是 Kai 总不愿意尝试新东西……我们帮他去探索吧。

l2>l3.en: Curious cooks find new tricks! Now, how sure are they about their moves?
l2>l3.zh: 好奇的小厨师会发现新窍门！那么，他们对自己的动作有多大把握呢？

l3>l4.en: They're almost real chefs! Time for the big soup contest. Let's go!
l3>l4.zh: 他们快成真正的厨师啦！做汤大赛要开始了，出发！

l4>final.en: What a team, {name}! Let's look back at everything you taught them.
l4>final.zh: 真是好团队，{name}！我们来回顾一下你教会他们的一切吧。
